challenge.rationale: Five teaching examples selected after complete evaluation: two normal and three anomalous images from distinct defect groups; prefer a genuine missed anomaly or normal review when available. Curated examples do not change benchmark membership or establish superiority.

dataset.modification_notice: Evaluator display/masks use unchanged source bytes. Separate model inputs re-encode unchanged RGB pixels without metadata.
